author: LegalEagle
description:
An AI recreation of a man killed in a road rage shooting delivered his own victim impact statement in an Arizona courtroom

Chris Pelkey was shot and killed in 2021 during a road rage altercation at a red light in Chandler, Arizona. 

When his sister Stacey Wales prepared her impact statement, her attorney told her to humanize him and give the court a complete picture of who he was. 

So she and her husband recreated him using old photos, video footage, and recordings of his voice.

At the shooter’s sentencing, the AI-generated Pelkey told the man who shot him that in another life they probably could have been friends, and that he believes in forgiveness. 

Maricopa County Superior Court Judge Todd Lang allowed the video under Arizona’s broad victim rights laws, the defense didn’t object, and the judge said, “I love that AI.”
